description_expanded: This beautiful 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Alys Beach vacation rental fronts Sea Garden Pedestrian Path leading directly to the beach to the south and a large fire pit to the north. The location is also steps away from the emerging Town Center. The living room, kitchen and primary bedroom surround the courtyard on the 1st floor and feature expansive windows that flood the rooms with natural light. The kitchen opens up to the plunge pool and lounge area. The living room is perfect for family gatherings and relaxing. The second floor has a landing with a day bed for reading or rest. The second bedroom features a king-sized bed and third features a set of bunk beds with the lower bunk a full-sized bed. The third floor boasts a roof-top terrace with a built-in grill and sitting area overlooking beautiful Alys Beach. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
